author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Getting the perfect drywall screw depth makes a big difference when hanging drywall. In this tip, I show you how to adjust the depth setter on a drywall screw gun, check your screws with a 4-inch knife, and fix any screws that are sitting too proud before you start taping.
